nodes.description: mintPrice: public sale price (0.28 ether), toggled by setPrice
presalePrice: fixed presale price (0.1 ether) checked in presalePurchase
presaleActive: gate flag (0/1) for presalePurchase
saleActive: gate flag (0/1) for public purchase
numWhiteMints: counter for white tokens, capped by MAX_SUPPLY_WHITE
numGoldMints: counter for gold tokens, capped by MAX_SUPPLY_GOLD
numMints: per-address mint counter enforcing max 10
whitelist: per-address presale eligibility flag, cleared after presale mint
numReserved: per-address reserved mint counter capped by MAX_RESERVED
setPrice(uint256): onlyOwner update of mintPrice
toggleSaleState(uint256): onlyOwner gate for public sale
togglePresaleState(uint256): onlyOwner gate for presale
reserveTokens(uint256): onlyOwner reserved mint, increments numReserved and numWhiteMints
withdraw(): onlyOwner splits contract balance 85/15 and transfers ETH
addWhitelist(address[]): onlyOwner batch whitelist assignment
presalePurchase(): payable whitelist mint using timestamp-derived randomness
purchase(): payable public mint using timestamp-derived randomness
redeemToken(uint256): burns id and mints id+2
uri(uint256): view metadata concatenation with exists() check
burn(address,uint256,uint256): override allowing owner/approved burn
msg.sender: caller identity used for auth, whitelist checks, mints and randomness
block.timestamp: used as entropy source for mint rarity selection
payable(...).transfer(): external ETH transfers of computed shares in withdraw
keccak256(abi.encodePacked(block.timestamp,msg.sender,nonce))%30 rarity roll in presalePurchase
keccak256(abi.encodePacked(block.timestamp,msg.sender,nonce))%30 rarity roll in purchase
_price parameter of setPrice
state parameter of toggleSaleState
state parameter of togglePresaleState
amount parameter of reserveTokens
addresses array parameter of addWhitelist
local balance of contract read in withdraw
local 85% share computed in withdraw
local 15% share computed in withdraw
local nonce constant used in presale randomness
local mintIndex rarity roll in presalePurchase
id parameter of redeemToken
account parameter of burn
id parameter of burn
value parameter of burn

normalization_plan.reason: _price is only a transient input to setPrice's mintPrice write; fold into the setPrice core node
state is only a transient input toggling saleActive; fold into toggleSaleState core node
state is only a transient input toggling presaleActive; fold into togglePresaleState core node
amount is a transient bound-checked argument of reserveTokens; fold into the function core node
addresses is a transient iterated array in addWhitelist; fold into the function core node
balance is an intermediate value of withdraw; fold into the withdraw core node
acct1_share is consumed directly by the ETH transfer operation; fold into that unsafe_operation
studio_share is consumed directly by the ETH transfer operation; fold into that unsafe_operation
nonce only feeds the presale keccak256 randomness preimage; fold into that unsafe_operation
mintIndex is the branch selector inside presalePurchase; fold into the function core node
id is the transient subject of redeemToken burn/mint; fold into the function core node
account is the transient authorization subject of burn; fold into the function core node
id is a transient argument forwarded to _burn; fold into the function core node
value is a transient argument forwarded to _burn; fold into the function core node
